items.q: dropped our friendship, at least, I did.

ctx.x: I went to Brownie's the other night, to hear Jimmy Rowles. And he came up to the piano and
said, "Evil --" He called me Evil. You were there. I wonder where he read that, because I've never even raised my voice at him. (Inaudible) dropped our friendship, at least, I did.
